name: Hissatsu Shigokinin ~Gakuen Kouman Onna Giri
original_name: 必殺シゴキ人～学園高慢女斬り
source:
The main character is a white-collar worker. But he secretly works as a substitute assaulter as well. One day, he receives a job offer. The targets are two female high school students, Ryoko and Aki....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090209124244/http://erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1007148]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名普通上班族，暗地里却以替人凌辱指定目标为业。某天，他接到一份委托，目标是两名女高中生——冲田凉子与间宫亚季……

[译自 [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090209124244/http://erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1007148]Eroge Shop[/url]]
